## 相关检查 / Relevant checks

<!-- 只勾选适用项，其他可标注不适用。Check applicable items; mark others as not applicable. -->

- [ ] 修改范围聚焦，相关文档已同步。/ The change is focused and relevant docs are updated.
- [ ] 玩法或联机改动验证了服务端权威及相关重试/重连流程。/ Gameplay or networking changes preserve server authority and relevant retry/reconnect flows.
- [ ] 涉及指引、开发功能或计时时，验证了权限和排行隔离。/ Guidance, debug, or timing changes preserve permission and ranking isolation.
- [ ] 新增第三方内容写明来源与许可，未提交凭据、签名材料或构建产物。/ New third-party content has source/license information; no credentials, signing material, or build output are included.
